data.exact_reserve_text: Favourable movements of GBP 9.1 million, (2015: GBP 13.7 million), in the past year's provision for claims outstanding, net of expected reinsurance recoveries, are included in claims incurred, net of reinsurance. These arose in respect of the following classes of business:
data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2016 the syndicate's gross claims outstanding were GBP 136.846m. During 2016 the syndicate recorded a gross release in prior year provisions of GBP 13.504m (a c.9.9% reduction versus opening gross reserves), resulting from favourable claims development across the portfolio. Net of reinsurance the report records a GBP 9.1m favourable movement included in claims incurred. The movement is presented in note 16 (technical provisions) and broken down by class (net amounts) in the claims note.
raw_causal_phrases: Favourable movements of GBP 9.1 million, (2015: GBP 13.7 million), in the past year's provision for claims outstanding, net of expected reinsurance recoveries, are included in claims incurred, net of reinsurance.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (Technical provisions - Claims outstanding) 2015 comparative column = GBP 136,846k (page 13). Prior year gross movement taken from Note 16 'Change in prior year provisions' gross column = (13,504)k (page 40)  interpreted as a GBP 13.504m release (negative). The claims note text and class-level table present net movements (net of reinsurance) totalling GBP 9.081m net favourable; per-class breakdown in that table is net, not gross. Per-LOB gross prior-year movements are not separately disclosed in gross terms, so lob_movements amounts are left null and flagged as inferred. Claims development triangle (gross, in GBP m) is present on page 39 and was used as a secondary cross-check. All monetary amounts are reported in the report's native currency (GBP).
